name: std/thread
description: Runs function-valued tasks and coordinates shared work with locks and conditions.
readme: Runs function-valued tasks and coordinates shared work with locks and conditions.
Import this module with use thread.

files.content:
-- Runs function-valued tasks and coordinates shared work with locks and conditions.
public define Thread as opaque.
public define Mutex as opaque.
public define Condition as opaque.
public use "thread" function spawn(task function giving nothing) giving failable pointer to Thread.
public use "thread" function wait(task pointer to Thread) giving failable nothing.
public use "thread" function mutex giving failable pointer to Mutex.
public use "thread" function lock(mutex pointer to Mutex) giving failable nothing.
public use "thread" function unlock(mutex pointer to Mutex) giving failable nothing.
public use "thread" function condition giving failable pointer to Condition.
public use "thread" function signal(condition pointer to Condition) giving failable nothing.
public use "thread" function pause(condition pointer to Condition, mutex pointer to Mutex) giving failable nothing.
public use "thread" function close[T](resource pointer to T) giving failable nothing.
